interface.producer: offset_hermite_tt(n,k,Fraction(L)) -> C; certify_scaled_canonicalize(C) -> SAME D,s,qr_packet; exactly ONE compile_mps(D) -> plan; actual plan.write_qasm2 and chronological manifest
interface.saved_word: Exact ASCII saved decimals are rational angles. Gate stream must byte-bind to manifest and partition into n stages, including empty stages. Stage i touches only bond wires n..n+a-1 and fresh data wire n-1-i.
interface.trig: For exact x=theta/2 evaluate explicit sin/cos Taylor sums through degree m. Remainder bound |x|^(m+1)/(m+1)! follows bounded derivatives; round endpoints outward on 2^-p grid. No exact trig callback. Concrete rational algorithm/Python-to-Lean refinement is OPEN.
interface.stage: Compose interval RY row-pairs and CX row permutations in chronological order on local 2B matrices. Midpoint Uhat, delta=max entry radius, eta=2B*delta. Surrogates may be nonunitary.
interface.full_action: K_i[in,bit,out]=Uhat_i[bit*B+out,in] with initial in=0, full B later. Append a-bit MSB-first delta routing tail retaining EVERY terminal label, including unreachable/padded labels.
interface.literal_target: Decode actual D float64 values exactly as rationals. Append a zero-ancilla tail; do NOT normalize D again. Both chains have scalar boundaries.
interface.coordinates: TT word data n-1..0 then bond a-1..0; phi(word)=j+2^n*b. This is not generic global MSB order.
interface.residual: q=G_Qhat+G_D-2*cross over ALL data/bond words by three exact local crossGram passes; directed rational r satisfies r^2>=q. sigma=product(1+eta_i)-1; candidate saved decimal bound sigma+r; QR packet may be composed separately. No phase quotient/postselection.
interface.consumer: Validated rational-chain consumer; frozen certify_pair is NOT called for Qhat vs D because it would normalize its raw target. Frozen cross_gram and sqrt_upper arithmetic may be reused after validated literal embeddings.

caps_are: Experimental execution limits, not scientific family restrictions or impossibility results. Exceeding limits is an honest LIMIT_REACHED failure.
test_seal: Actual n3k1L1 normal-producer fixture, same C/D/plan identity and saved chronology
No dense constructor/checker input: primary path forbids TT.small_dense_diagnostic; tiny independent saved Qiskit replay is separately diagnostic
Missing/extra fixture files and instructions fail closed; byte hash, malformed decimal, stage span, reused-data and wire mutations reject
Valid rebound angle/sign/order mutations give changed full residual; no manifest-acceptance-as-accuracy inference
Endian/readout mutant discrimination, terminal ancilla excitation retained, no active-bond-only truncation
Zero/deficient/tall rational core validation, empty stage, a=0 empty tail, directed sqrt exact-zero/tie/non-square
Rational trig remainder and outward endpoint checks; deterministic replay fixture hash equality
Explicit all-work records: decode, QR/completion/atan2, interval arithmetic, contraction, integer sqrt, bit growth, Fraction/GCD caveat, copies, text I/O
binders_and_definitions: No new source-facing theorem or scientific premise. Literal stored objects and saved decimal action, original signed Hermite target unchanged. Experimental caps are operational only.
evidence_class: Executable finite saved-action residual candidate, NOT Lean proof, source-blind review, publication, ROOT, uniform finite-bit bound or PURIFIED.
open: uniform source-to-stored-C error and source norm floor
